lines: 这人蒙圣灵赐他智慧的言语，
那人也蒙这位圣灵赐他知识的言语，
For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom
and to another the word of knowledge
according to the same Spirit;
这人蒙圣灵赐他智慧的言语，
那人也蒙这位圣灵赐他知识的言语，
這人蒙聖靈賜他智慧的言語，
那人也蒙這位聖靈賜他知識的言語，
For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom
and to another the word of knowledge
according to the same Spirit;
For to one are given words of wisdom through the Spirit; and to another words of knowledge through the same Spirit:
我作孩子的时候，话语像孩子，
心思像孩子，意念像孩子，
既成了人，就把孩子的事丢弃了。
When I was a child
I spoke as a child
I felt as a child
I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man
I have put away childish things.
我作孩子的时候，话语像孩子，
心思像孩子，意念像孩子，
既成了人，就把孩子的事丢弃了。
我作孩子的時候，話語像孩子，
心思像孩子，意念像孩子，
既成了人，就把孩子的事丟棄了。
When I was a child
I spoke as a child
I felt as a child
I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man
I have put away childish things.
When I was a child
I made use of a child's language
I had a child's feelings and a child's thoughts: now that I am a man
I have put away the things of a child.
你们要追求爱，也要切慕属灵的恩赐，
其中更要羡慕的，是作先知讲道
Follow after love
and earnestly desire spiritual gifts
but especially that you may prophesy.

Follow after love
and earnestly desire spiritual gifts
but especially that you may prophesy.
Go after love; still desiring to have the things which the Spirit gives
but most of all that you may have the prophet's power.
这必朽坏的既变成不朽坏的，
这必死的既变成不死的，
那时经上所记「死被得胜吞灭」的话就应验了。
But when this perishable body will have become imperishable
and this mortal will have put on immortality
then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”
这必朽坏的既变成不朽坏的，
这必死的既变成不死的，
那时经上所记「死被得胜吞灭」的话就应验了。
這必朽壞的既變成不朽壞的，
這必死的既變成不死的，
那時經上所記「死被得勝吞滅」的話就應驗了。
But when this perishable body will have become imperishable
and this mortal will have put on immortality
then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”
But when this has taken place
then that which was said in the Writings will come true
Death is overcome by life.
凡遵守主道的，爱神的心在他里面实在是完全的。从此我们知道我们是在主里面。
But whoever keeps his word
God’s love has most certainly been perfected in him. This is how we know that we are in him:
凡遵守主道的，爱神的心在他里面实在是完全的。从此我们知道我们是在主里面。

But in every man who keeps his word
the love of God is made complete. By this we may be certain that we are in him:
父老啊，我曾写信给你们，
因为你们认识那从起初原有的。少年人哪，
我曾写信给你们；因为你们刚强，
神的道常存在你们心里；
你们也胜了那恶者。
I have written to you
fathers
because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you
young men
because you are strong
and the word of God remains in you
and you have overcome the evil one.

fathers
because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you
young men
because you are strong
and the word of God remains in you

I have sent a letter to you
fathers
because you have knowledge of him who was from the first. I have sent a letter to you
young men
because you are strong
and the word of God is in you
and because you have overcome the Evil One.

and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God
neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
In this way it is clear who are the children of God and who are the children of the Evil One; anyone who does not do righteousness or who has no love for his brother
is not a child of God.

what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?

But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News

but God

But even as the good news was given to us by the approval of God
so we give it out; not as pleasing men
but God by whom our hearts are tested.

也必与他同活。
For he was crucified through weakness
yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him
but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

For he was crucified through weakness
yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him
but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.
For he was feeble in that he was put to death on the cross
but he is living by the power of God. And we are feeble in him
but we will be living with him through the power of God in relation to you.
